intro: The professions a player picks from when creating a character in this world: the skills it trains, where the professional points of creation go, and what it starts every game with.
empty: No profession yet: no character could be created in this world.
descriptionHint: One line in English, shown to the player who picks a profession.
skillsHint: Among the skills of the world, at least one: the professional points of creation go to these alone.
noSkills: The world has no skill yet: add some in the World tab first.
startingItemsHint: JSON list, empty for none. Each item names an item of the world (definition, never one of a scenario), with a line of English telling it apart (descriptor, or null), how many (quantity) and whether it is worn or wielded (equipped). Added to what each scenario gives.
startingResourcesHint: JSON object, empty for none: a number for each resource of the world, by reference.
inUse: Characters follow this profession: it cannot be removed.
